title: Penthouse April 2009 Erica Ellyson Veronica Ricci Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, April 2009. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover: Erica Ellyson of NBC's Momma's Boys. Pet of the Month: Veronica Ricci.

Cover features: Down & Dirty with Erica Ellyson; Manhattan Madam on ex-Gov. Spitzer; Baseball preview with AL MVP Dustin Pedroia; Rumble in the Jungle - cops vs. cartels in the Amazon.

Back cover: Djarum clove cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
